      • cleanUpLastPage

        public void cleanUpLastPage()
                     throws General
        Removes the internally stored data (images, documents) of the last page from the system. Removing the last page is useful when a wrong page has scanned, e.g. because the scanned image is blurred or accidentally wrong document page has been scanned.
        Throws:
        General
